evals.prompt: Create a project specification document for a small order-tracking REST service written in Go. Cover goals, non-goals, glossary, functional requirements, and design decisions.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown project document with a version comment, glossary table, requirement ID tables, and the skill's sentence-per-line style.
expectations: The document contains a version HTML comment directly below the H1.
Requirements are presented in tables with identifier columns.
Every table is aligned by source-text width with separator width equal to column width plus two hyphens.
Prose uses one sentence per paragraph and straight ASCII quotes.

evals.prompt: Napisz krótki artykuł po polsku o tym, czym jest bufor cykliczny, z przykładem użycia w systemie wbudowanym.
evals.expected_output: A Polish article with sentence-case headings, correct diacritics, and narrative paragraphs.
expectations: Section headings use sentence case, not Title Case.
All Polish diacritics are preserved and written in composed form.
The document contains no typographic quotes and no semicolons in prose.
Tables, if present, are source-width aligned.

evals.prompt: Edit the supplied existing project document that uses numbered chapters (# 1, ## 1.1): add a new functional requirement and a new use case in the middle of the document.
evals.expected_output: An in-place edit that preserves numbered chapters, the document's encoding, and its table conventions with a minimal diff.
expectations: Section numbering stays continuous and correct after the insertion.
No unrelated section was reformatted or reworded.
New table rows follow the document's existing table style and padding.
The file's original encoding and line-ending style are preserved.

evals.prompt: Fix the formatting of the misaligned Markdown tables in this document so they are readable as plain text.
evals.expected_output: The same document with every table compacted and pipe-aligned by source width.
expectations: All pipes in each table column align vertically in plain-text view.
Column widths were measured on source text including backticks and emphasis markers.
Each separator row is column width plus two hyphens.
No table content was shortened or changed.

evals.prompt: Zapisz szybką notatkę z planowania: trzy punkty do omówienia i dwie pozycje otwarte.
evals.expected_output: A minimal Polish note, possibly without an H1, with informal list structure.
expectations: The note stays minimal - no forced template sections.
Task items use the - [ ] syntax.
Polish diacritics are preserved.

evals.prompt: Update two paragraphs in this legacy document that is stored in CP1250 encoding with CRLF line endings.
evals.expected_output: An edit that detects and preserves the CP1250 encoding and CRLF line endings.
expectations: The file remains in CP1250 after the edit.
Line endings remain CRLF.
The agent ran encoding detection before writing.

evals.prompt: Add a new topic page documenting the retry helpers to this Sphinx documentation project.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case Markdown page in docs/source/, written in the dominant dialect of the surrounding pages, with a new entry added to the index.rst toctree.
expectations: The agent detected the sphinx-docs scope before writing.
The new page filename is lowercase kebab-case.
The page heading style matches the dominant dialect of the neighboring pages.
The page is registered as a toctree entry in index.rst without other changes to that file.
No unrelated files were modified.

evals.prompt: Add a new rule file covering glossary conventions to this agent skill repository and register it.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case rule file in the correct directory, registered in SKILL.md under the matching directory section, with Contents and README kept in sync.
expectations: The agent detected the agent-skill scope before writing.
The new file follows the target directory's naming convention.
SKILL.md gained a registration line saying what the file covers and when to load it.
Affected Contents tables and the README directory tree were updated.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this directory that has no documentation structure.
evals.expected_output: A standalone README.md written to the location named by the request, with no registration or index updates performed.
expectations: The agent reported the unstructured-layout scope.
No index, router, or registry file was created or modified.
The filename follows the language file naming rules or a type-conventional name.

evals.prompt: Write an implementation plan for the new retry feature in this guided project.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case plan document placed in docs/plan/<current-version>/ with an -implementation suffix, carrying the project's version comment convention.
expectations: The agent detected the guided-project scope and read the project's guidelines document first.
The plan file sits in docs/plan/ under the current version directory.
The filename is kebab-case with the -implementation suffix.
The document carries the project's version-comment convention.
No version number was bumped.

evals.prompt: Add a new engineering standard for Kotlin development to this documentation repository.
evals.expected_output: A rules-voice standard document at docs/standard/kotlin-development.md, following the repository's own style documents.
expectations: The agent detected the docs-collection scope.
The new file is named docs/standard/kotlin-development.md.
The document follows the shape of the neighboring standard documents.
No governing rule file was modified.

evals.prompt: Document the import pipeline in the converter subproject of this multi-project repository.
evals.expected_output: A document inside converter/docs/ that follows that subproject's own conventions, with no root-level or sibling-project files touched.
expectations: The agent resolved the scope per directory and applied the subproject's nearest governing documents.
The new document sits inside the converter subproject's docs tree.
Conventions were not mixed across project boundaries.
No files outside the target subproject were modified.

evals.prompt: Discover the document layout of this repository.
evals.expected_output: An inline layout report naming the best-matching scope with its signal basis, matched and missing signals per candidate, document-type classification, and exceptions.
expectations: The agent ran the scope signal census tool on the target directory.
The verdict names a scope and whether the match is full, partial, or closest.
Matched and missing signals are listed for the candidate scopes.
Exceptions and documents no scope covers are reported, not hidden.
No file was created or modified in the analyzed location.

evals.prompt: Wykryj układ dokumentów w tym katalogu.
evals.expected_output: An inline Polish layout report naming the best-matching scope or the unstructured fallback, with signals and exceptions.
expectations: The report is delivered in Polish, matching the request language.
The agent ran the scope signal census on the target directory.
The verdict names a scope with its basis, or unstructured-layout when nothing matches.
Exceptions and unclassified documents are reported.
The report is inline - no file was written.
